notes: §1985:VI.6.7.4 GR1: "Execution of the ALTER statement modifies the GO TO statement in the paragraph named procedure-name-1 so that subsequent executions of the modified GO TO statement cause transfer of control to procedure-name-2", and "Modified GO TO statements in independent segments may, under some circumstances, be returned to their initial states" (the circumstances are §1985:XVI.1.4.3's). AlterEnsureScan gives each ALTERed paragraph a switch field (EmitFields: the written target, or none for a target-less GO TO), AlterGoTo/AlterBindBareGoTo bind its GO TO through the field (EmitGoTo) and BindAlter/EmitAlter store procedure-name-2; since kb/Work PB5084 AlterSwitchEmitter.EmitSegmentState with DispatchEmitter.EmitDispatchMethod resets an independent segment's switches whenever control enters it from another segment, the second sentence the prior PARTIAL found missing. Probed at --std 85 (classes b, c, d): with no ALTER the GO TO goes to A; ALTER with and without PROCEED, to a paragraph and to a section, and of a target-less GO TO, retarget it (A, B, C, S2); in SECTION 60 the switch is INITIAL after three PERFORMs from segment 0 and after two fall-throughs from segment 20, and ALTERED only on a GO TO inside the segment; the same program with SECTION 40 prints INITIAL then ALTERED throughout; at --std 2002 ALTER is COBOL0810. The witness: one ALTER of an unsegmented paragraph, A then B.
